records.text: The star witness of the case was actually a housekeeper named Carmen (housekeeper; surname unverified) who testified how Corey would come to her and ask her to buy drugs on her behalf, which allowed them to then speculate if this is how she got her hands on an illicit street drug.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
